full_judgment:
3. It is the case. of plaintiffs that, suit property originally belongs to Chandra Kumar Loadh, Raj Kumar Loadh, Mohendra Kumar Loadh and Debendra Kumar Loadh. Chandra Kumar Loadh died leaving two sons, Kamini Kumar Loadh and Nalini Loadh; Mohendra Kumar Loadh died leaving two sons, Vobesh Chandra Loadh and Dhirendra Kumar Loadh and Raj Kumar Loadh died leaving three sons, Horendra Kumar Loadh, Jogendra Kumar Loadh and Monaranjan Loadh. Debendra Kumar Loadh died unmarried and his share was recorded in the name of original owner, Chandra Kumar Loadh and in the name some of their heirs at Revisional survey, MRR Khatian No.30. Said property, after gradual devolution, devolved upon their heirs i.e Horendra Kumar Loadh, Jogendra Kumar Loadh, Monaranjan Loadh. Horendra Kumar Loadh, Jogendra Kumar Loadh and Mohendra Kumar Loadh sold the suit land to plaintiff Nos. 1-8. Plaintiff No. 9, Habib Ullah sold his purchased land of khatian No. 19 and dag No.533 to plaintiff No. 19, Nalini Kumar Loadh, Jamini Kumar Loadh and one of the original owner by Saf kabala deed dated 10-4-1970 and 11-4-1970 sold 0.16 acres from 'Ka' schedule of dag No. 533 and 1.64 acres of land of dag No. 535, in total, 1.80 acres of land to Mohammad Shah Alam and plaintiff No. 10 Fazlul Hoque. Thereafter, Mohammad Shah Alam died leaving brother, plaintiff No. 25, plaintiffs Nos. 26/27 are sisters and one wife, plaintiff No. 28. While Shah Alam was alive, he sold 6 decimals of land by Saf kabala deed dated 8-1-1979 from dag No. 535 to plaintiffs Nos. 17 and 19. Plaintiff No. 10 by Safkabala deed dated 30-6-1976 sold 0.04 acres of land from 'Ka' schedule of dag No. 535 and 24 decimals of land of dag No. 535, in total, 28 decimals of land to plaintiff No. 22. Plaintiff No. 10, Fazlul Hoque, by registered deed dated 29-6-1976 sold 28 decimals of land from the aforesaid dag to plaintiff No. 14. Plaintiff No. 10 by another saf kabala deed sold, 29 decimals of land out of dag No. 505 to plaintiff No. 29. Vobesh Chandra Loadh son of Mohendra Kumar Loadh, Omreta Kumar Loadh, son of, Jamini Kumar Loadh, Jogendra Kumar Loadh, son of, Raj Kumar Loadh, Nolini Kumar Loadh, son of, Chandra Kumar Loadh and Devendra Kumar Loadh, son of, Mohendra Kumar Loadh by registered saf kabala deed dated 13-10-1978 and 5- 1-1979 sold 2.35 acres of land from 'Ka' schedule from dag 536, khatian No. 19, from dag No. 565, 17 decimals, from dag No. 534, 7 decimals of land, in total, 89 decimals of land to plaintiff Nos. 11 and 12. The aforesaid heirs of original owners by registered saf kabala deed dated 19-1-1979 sold, in total, 1.07 acres of land from dag No. 535, 556,465 to plaintiff No. 10. Aforesaid heirs of the original owners by registered saf kabala deed dated 29-1-1979 sold, 5 decimals of land from dag No. 536, 5 decimals of land from dag No. 534 and 5 decimals of land from dag No. 465, in total, 15 decimals of land to plaintiff No. 13. Aforesaid heirs of the original owners sold 4 decimals of land from dag No. 534, 2 decimals of land from dag No. 365, 6 decimals of land from dag No. 536, in total, 12 decimals of land by registered saf kabala deed dated 23-10-1978 to plaintiff No. 17 and also to the predecessor-in-interest of plaintiffs Nos. 25-28 i.e. Shah Alam. Aforesaid heirs of the original owners by registered saf kabala deed dated 7-2-1979 sold in total 53 decimals of land to plaintiff Nos. 24 and also to the predecessor-in-interest of plaintiff Nos. 25-28. The aforesaid heirs by registered saf kabala deed dated 7-2-1979 sold 43 decimals of land to plaintiff Nos. 19, 17 and 23. Plaintiff No. 10 by registered saf kabala deed No. 3120 dated 11-4-1970 sold 28 decimals of land to plaintiff No. 22. Plaintiff No. 10 by registered saf kabala deed dated 6-7-1976 sold 28 decimals ofland to plaintiff No. 14. Plaintiff No. 31 by registered saf kabala deed dated 5-2-1973 sold 22 decimals of land to plaintiff No. 9, Habib Ullah. 

 4. In this way plaintiffs Nos. 1-10, 11, 12, 14, 17, 19,23,24,25-28 and 31 purchased in total 4.57 acres of land and in possession. This property along with other properties have been recorded in the khatian as per description made in the plaint. Plaintiff Nos. 2-11 purchased land from plaintiff No. 15 and 20 in total 1.24 acres of land by registered safkabala deed dated 15-2-1976. Plaintiff No. 15 purchased 1.22 acres of land from plaintiff No. 16 and plaintiff No. 17 sold his land to plaintiff No. 18. Plaintiff No. 20 by amicable settlement in between predecessor of dag No. 534 and 537 got in total 29 decimals of land, sold the same to plaintiff No. 11 and 14. Nolini Kumar Loadh, son of, Chandra Kumar Loadh sold 1.20 acres of land to plaintiff No. 15,20,21 and 22 from suit dag. Thereafter, plaintiff No. 20 on amica- ble partition got 29 decimals of land of dag No. 543/537 and by registered safkabala deed dated 21- 6-1976 sold the said land to plaintiff No. 11 and 14. Jamini Kumar Loadh and Nalini Kumar Loadh, sons of, Chandra Kumar Loadh on amicable partition got 29 decimals of land from dag No. 532, 15 decimals of land from dag No. 609 and 2 decimals of land from dag No. 521/1458, in total, 46 decimals of land, sold by registered saf kabala deed dated 20-3- 1970 to Mohammad Shah Alam who in turn sold 15 decimals of land of his purchased land by registered safkabala deed dated 4-3-1971 to plaintiff No. 16, 17 and 18. Plaintiff Nos. 25-28 as heirs inherited remaining portion of land Horendra Kumar Loadh and Jogendra Kumar Loadh son of Raj Kumar Loadh by registered kabala deed dated 16-6-1970 sold in total 35 decimals of land to plaintiff No. 23. Mohendra Kumar Loadh died leaving two sons Dhirendra Kumar Loadh and Vobesh Kumar Loadh as heirs who inherited his property and sold 9 decimals of land of dag No. 524 and 13 decimals of land from dag No. 521 in total 26 decimals of land to plaintiff No. 24. The aforesaid heirs also sold 36 decimals of land from dag No. 545, 17 decimals of land from dag No. 564, 17 decimals of land from dag No. 566 and 6 decimals of land from dag No. 541 in total 76 decimals of land by registered saf kabala deed No. 3122 dated 11-4-1970 to plaintiff No.9, Habib Ullah, Siddique Ullah, predecessor-in- interest of plaintiff Nos. 1-8 in own name and also in the name of plaintiff No. 6 purchased 28 decimals of land from dag No. 537, 38 decimals of land from dag No. 540 in total 66 decimals of land by registered safkabala deed dated 22-7-1970 from heir of Raj Kumar Loadh. Plaintiff No. 6 is a benamder of Siddique Ullah, Nolini Kumar Loadh son of Chandra Kumar Loadh and Debendra Kumar Loadh son of Mohendra Kumar Loadh by registered saf kabala deed dated 5-1-1979 sold in total 2:12 acres of land from dag No. 520 and 531 to plaintiff No. 11 and 12. Debendra Kumar Loadh son of Mahesh Chandra Loadh and Manik Kumar Loadh son of Jamini Kumar Loadh by registered saf kabala deed dated 29-1-1979 sold 1.44 acres of land from dag No. 362/520/524/525/526/527/528/529/531/532/ 537/538/544/545/564/566 and 608 of schedule 'Kha' khatian No. 89 to plaintiff No. 13. Aforesaid heirs also sold by registered saf kabala deed dated 29.79 in total 41 decimals of land from dag No. 362, 537,530 and 532 to plaintiff No. 10, Fazlul Hoque, The aforesaid heirs also sold 24 decimals of land by. registered safkabala deed dated 22-7-1977 to plaintiff No. 9 and to the predecessor-in-interest to plaintiff Nos. 1-8 and 6. The aforesaid heirs also by registered saf kabala deed dated 20-10-1978 sold in total 71 decimals of land to plaintiff No. 17 who also purchased from plaintiff No. 25-28. The aforesaid heirs who are owners also sold 15 decimals of land of dag No. 586, 13 decimals of land of dag No. 530, 6 decimals of land of dag No. 529, 5 decimals of land of dag No. 531, 19 decimals of land of dag No. 536,4 decimals of land of dag No. 525, 4 decimals of land of dag No. 524, 8 decimals of land of dag No. 526, 8 decimals of land of dag No. 521, decimals of land of dag No. 541, 20 decimals of land of dag No. 543, 74 decimals of land of dag No. 520 in total 1.83 acres of land to plaintiff No. 24 and predecessor-in-interest of plaintiff Nos. 25-28 by registered safkabala deed dated 7-2-1979. The aforesaid heirs from khatian No. 79 by registered saf kabala deed dated 7-2-1979 sold in total 99 decimals of land from dag Nos. 586, 525, 526, 529, 530, 531, 607,608,520 and 527 to plaintiff Nos. 14, 19 and 23. Plaintiff No. 15 by registered kabala deed dated 16-3-1970 sold 15 decimals of land to plaintiff No. 32, SharifUllah. Plaintiff No. 15 also sold by registered saf kabala deed dated 16-4-1973 to plaintiff Nos. 16, 17 and 18,22 decimals of land to plaintiff No. 21 and 14 and 18 decimals of land was sold to plaintiff No. 14 from khatian No. 89. Plaintiff No. 14 also sold 22 decimals of land to plaintiff Nos. 16, 17 and 18. Plaintiff No. 21 sold 18 decimals of land to plaintiff No. 14, who in turn on 1-1-1979 sold his land to plaintiff Nos. 16, 17 and 18. Plaintiff No.9 sold in total 40 decimals of land to plaintiff No. 19 by registered safkabala, who in turn sold the land to plaintiff Nos. 1-22/23-28 and 32, in total, they are in possession of 8.31 acres of land. Sharbat Ali others are in possession 50 decimals of land i.e. 16 annas land of dag No. 361 of khatian No. 89. Chandra Kumar Loadh and Mohabuddin Hazi were owners of land of khatian No. 88 in equal 8 annas share. Mohendra Kumar Loadh and Mohabuddin Hazi on amicable partition got land of MRR khatian No. 129 of Sadgho'ria mouza. Remaining 8 annas share have been recorded in the name of Omreta Kumar Loadh and said land was sold to plaintiff No. 21, 15 and 20 by registered saf kabala deed dated 16-3-1970. Plaintiff No. 20 by registered saf kabala deed dated 21-6-1976 sold 8 decimals of land from dag No. 461 and 464 to plaintiff No. 11 and 14. The land of khatian No. 14 was owned by Saroda Kumar Loadh and Radha Sundari Nath and they sold 47 decimals of land to plaintiff Nos. 25-28 by registered safkabala deed dated 26-3-1970 and 7 decimals of land from dag No. 613 to Shahadat Ullah and Md Shafi Ullah who as heirs, inherited the property which they by registered saf kabala deed dated 20-11-1960, sold their inherited land to plaintiff No. 19 Md Zafor Ullah, who sold 7 decimals of land to plaintiff Nos  16,17 and 18. Orun Chandra Loadh, Motilal Loadh and Manik Chandra Loadh, sons of Jamini Kumar Loadh of khatian No. 14 of dag No. 792 sold 15 decimals of land by registered kabala deed dated 20-2- 1979 to plaintiff No. 17 and 25-28. 

 10. In this way aforesaid schedule properties are owned by purchase by registered saf kabala by the plaintiffs, they mutated their names in the respective khatian spaying rents regularly. Subsequently they have got notice that the suit land has been recorded by the defendants as enemy and nonresident property. They filed Title Suit No. 149 of 1986 with the aforesaid prayer.
